description:
## Problem
PR #4189 made evaluate_vendor_conditions (benchbox/validation/bundle.py) refuse any Databricks result that declares a preview_features entry, even with vendor_permission recorded. The vendor-terms ADR (benchbox-site docs/development/adr/adr-client-link-locality-disclosure.md, Terms check) excludes Databricks Beta services with no override; it does not mention Preview. preview_features is one list for Beta, Preview and early-access, so the validator cannot tell them apart and now refuses Preview results that the ADR may allow with permission.

## Decision gate (owner)
Read the Databricks terms row in the ADR and choose:
1. Keep: refuse every declared feature on Databricks (current behaviour); record that the owner accepts over-refusal of Preview.
2. Split: add a field or a value convention that distinguishes Beta from Preview; refuse Beta unconditionally and let Preview pass with vendor_permission.
The decision is recorded in context and in the ADR before any code changes.

## Guardrails
- Beta stays refused under either option.
- Other vendors' rules do not change.
- A schema change to the manifest needs a versioned schema bump and a validator test for old manifests.
- The site checklist (docs/vendor-publishing-checklist.md) must match the validator after the change.
